metadata.purpose: Full SHT FFT-target comparison of the isolated AVX2 radix-11 odd-ido-tail helper against M25.

metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2 dispatch

metadata.dispatch_note: The f64 AVX2 radix-11 dispatcher computes odd final inner values across adjacent outer-group pairs when l1 >= 2. The final odd outer group uses the scalar path. N=682's dedicated ido=31 kernel and inverse safety fallback remain unchanged; f32 and CPUs without AVX2 retain scalar processing.
metadata.layout_note: The tail helper is in src/simd/x86/f64_kernel/radix11_odd_ido_tail.rs and is out of line; SimdKernels remains unchanged.
metadata.previous_captures: The initial in-module variant is recorded in m26-radix11-odd-tail-six-pairs.jsonl; the dispatch-refined variant is recorded in m26-radix11-odd-tail-refined-six-pairs.jsonl. Both remain diagnostic. This capture uses the separately isolated helper source patch.
